label: No two distinct beings each MOTION_1 move the other while each is being moved
paraphrase: Conclusion: there are no distinct a and b and respects r and s with a moving b in r, b moving a in s, a being moved in s and b being moved in r (MOTION_1). Derived from the strong per se premise 1e47e6db-da06-5a40-9ccf-fbd1f929c596 and the regress 226c38f6-7bf4-552a-9a85-733cfa41d0fa; it is the negation of 4f6ac439-627d-43f2-9364-2700cd4a49d2, so the bundle of those three statements is inconsistent and at least one member must go, not a preferred one.
